resolution.rationale: The move of the required artifact from spec.md to bug.md is not a widening BUG-041 introduced. It is the correction of a PRE-EXISTING defect in artifact-lint.sh, which applied a literal feature-shaped required list to bug packets. Verified on four independent pieces of evidence, each re-derived in this session rather than taken on trust.
evidenceVerified: bubbles/registry/bug-packet.yaml, forms: -> form: full -> artifacts: declares exactly bug.md, design.md, scopes.md, report.md, uservalidation.md, scenario-manifest.json (conditional), state.json. spec.md is ABSENT from that list; bug.md is IN it. Requiring spec.md was never contract.

The prose restatements agree with the registry: agents/bubbles_shared/bug-templates.md mentions spec.md zero times, and micro-fix-packet.yaml delegates artifacts to bug-packet.yaml. No second authority points the other way.

Nothing mechanically consumes spec.md from a bug packet. The only hit across bubbles/scripts/** is a prose comment at guards/tail-delegated-gates.sh:522 citing BUG-037's file by path. No guard, lint or resolver reads it, so dropping the requirement orphans no consumer.

Census of all 8 packets under bugs/: every one carries bug.md, so the corrected requirement refuses nothing that exists. All 7 packets that resolve to the full form also carry spec.md, so dropping that requirement refuses nothing either. No verdict moves in either direction, so the choice between the two sets is settled purely by which one is the contract, and that is the registry.

Decisive argument is this design's own section 4, which rejects hard-coding an artifact branch inside artifact-lint.sh because it 'creates a third private copy of the contract. The defect, relocated.' The hard-coded spec.md requirement WAS such a private copy, disagreeing with the registry IMP-047 S-B made the single bug-artifact authority.

findings.statement: A compact packet still cannot reach done through the transition guard. bug-packet.yaml's compact form has no scopes.md, so there are no DoD checkboxes for Check 4 and no scope status markers for Check 5; both block with 'cannot verify completion' and 'no scope status markers'. micro-fix-packet.yaml preserves adversarial-regression as an obligation, but bug-packet.yaml scopes its mechanical expression (regressionExpectations, the Regression E2E Test Plan row and the two DoD checkboxes) to appliesToForms [full], so on a compact packet the guard has no artifact in which to look for it.

findings.disposition: ADJUDICATED, and ROUTED OUT of this packet to a NEW packet. bubbles.implement's refusal to repair it is UPHELD: it is a contract question owned by the registries, not a code defect in the guard. The adjudication is recorded in design.md section 8. DECISION: (1) CARRIER - two carriers, not one. micro-fix-packet.yaml's preservedObligations requirement text already names where each obligation is DISCHARGED: report.md for reproduce-before-fix, adversarial-regression and evidence-is-execution, bug.md for root-cause-stated. Where completion is ATTESTED is a separate question and the answer is uniformly report.md, because report.md's declared purpose is evidence and a completion claim is an evidence claim, whereas bug.md's declared purpose is analysis. state.json was considered and rejected: an agent-writable control-plane field that grants completion is the self-certification shape escalation.overrideFlag none exists to prevent. The implementer's report.md hypothesis is CONFIRMED for the attestation and for three of four discharge sites, and is WRONG for root-cause-stated. (2) MECHANISM - reuse obligationsRetained rather than invent a field, adding per-entry dischargedIn and attestedIn keys, and deliberately OMITTING requirement on the compact entries because micro-fix-packet.yaml owns that text and copying it would fork a single authority. (3) BOUNDARY - NEW PACKET, ruled against widening BUG-041. (4) micro-fix-packet.yaml does NOT change; report-sections.yaml does NOT change; only bug-packet.yaml changes normatively.

adjudication.verdict: Finding is VALID and its severity is understated. The registry declares adversarial-regression preserved on the compact form and, in the same file, scopes its only mechanical expression (regressionExpectations) to appliesToForms [full]. That is sharper than 'there are no checkboxes'.
framingCorrections: obligationsRetained on the single-file form is STRUCTURED but is NOT machine-read. bug-packet-resolve.sh parses only the artifacts: key inside a form and the top-level declaration: block; obligationsRetained sets in_artifacts FALSE and its entries are skipped. Running the resolver emits 22 lines of form=/default=/field=/location=/vocab=/alias=/artifact= and ZERO obligation facts. The single-file precedent supplies VOCABULARY, not a working mechanism, so the resolver must learn a new emission kind either way.

bug-packet-resolve.sh has NO --resolve-form verb. That verb is on micro-fix-admission.sh (consumed at state-transition-guard.sh line ~782). bug-packet-resolve.sh accepts only --registry FILE and emits stable one-fact-per-line output. The seam is therefore a NEW OUTPUT LINE KIND, not a new verb, which adds no argument surface and lets existing consumers ignore an unrecognised kind for free.

The compact form declares its three artifact ids with NO purpose: field, unlike full (all seven) and single-file (its one). The form does not say what its artifacts are FOR, which is why the carrier had to be derived from the sibling registry. Folded into the same change list as a secondary gap.

Relocate a free-authored DoD list to report.md (the implementer's hypothesis, taken literally) - works, but the author writes the list so the guard can only count unchecked items and never knows the list is COMPLETE. Reproduces full's weakness in a form that need not inherit it.

notes: INVESTIGATION, PACKET AND DESIGN ONLY. No framework script was edited, because bash bubbles/scripts/cli.sh framework-validate was executing at pid 15125 throughout this session and state-transition-guard-selftest.sh references artifact-lint 53 times. The defect is reproduced with real exit codes in report.md: micro-fix-admission.sh admits bugs/BUG-038-progress-timeout-bsd-wc-padding at exit 0 while artifact-lint.sh rejects the same packet at exit 1 with 6 issues. Root cause is that bubbles/registry/bug-packet.yaml, the declared single bug-artifact authority, has NO production reader; both artifact-lint.sh (lines 401-406, 447, 453) and state-transition-guard.sh (lines 759, 799, 805) carry byte-identical hard-coded copies of the full form's set. TWO CORRECTIONS TO THE DISPATCHING BRIEF, both measured. First, the brief reported no machine-readable declaration; state.json field .packet exists, holds "micro", and is consumed at micro-fix-admission.sh:144, so the real faults are that no registry declares the field and that "micro" is outside bug-packet.yaml's declared vocabulary of full/compact/single-file. Second, the brief framed all six lint failures as one defect; four are, and two are an authoring gap in BUG-038 whose report.md carries its evidence under non-registry headings. That second finding is ROUTED, not repaired, and is recorded in reworkQueue RQ-B041-1. A THIRD SURFACE was discovered that the brief did not mention: state-transition-guard.sh carries the same duplicate list, so repairing only artifact-lint.sh would leave the guard rejecting the packet the lint accepts. The chosen design follows the framework's own IMP-047 S-B precedent, one registry plus one shared reader, rather than a hard-coded branch, because a branch inside artifact-lint.sh would be a third private copy of the contract. Non-vacuity rests on three structural properties and six mutations: an absent declaration fails closed to full, a declared compact form must additionally survive admission so declaring is never a bypass, and a missing or empty registry exits non-zero rather than degrading to an empty requirement set. The load-bearing measurement is that six of the seven bug packets carry no .packet declaration at all, so their verdict cannot change by construction. M6 diffs every packet's verdict before and after and is the acceptance gate. The fix is deliberately NOT expected to make BUG-038 pass: the correct post-fix result is 6 issues into 2, and a result of 0 means the evidence contract was relaxed and the fix over-reached.
